videos.description: Religion keeps adding pulleys: pray more, fast more, give more, and maybe the weight will finally move. videos.title: One and the Same
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description:
The world says count to ten when life presses in; the gospel says count to one. Through the cross Jesus joined Himself to you, and you are now one spirit with Him. Your sufficiency is not something you produce under pressure — it is Someone who lives inside you.
